messages:
sara: Heads-up — planning an opt-in edge canary for EU low-latency routing (model-v2). Goal: 5% EU traffic, p95 <= 100ms, two-week bake. Need flag naming, telemetry gates, and fallback plan. Thoughts?
mike: +1. Do we want this per-tenant opt-in or region-wide cohorts? per-region is simpler to start with.

leila: Customers who requested private low-latency want per-tenant opt-ins for control. Maybe region-wide first, then expose per-tenant opt-in after bake.

james: Ops note — pick a low-traffic window for the first 24h (UTC early morning). Also need quota reservations on Dedicated pools so canary doesn't starve other services.

anna: eng-runtime: suggest flag name: `edge_eu_lowlat_v2`. Rollout: cohort weight 5% region-wide. Fallback: route back to model-v1. Telemetry keys: latency.p95, errors.rate, quality.regressions.

mike: Gating proposal: allow rollout if p95 < 100ms AND errors.rate < 0.5% AND quality.regressions <= 1% on our eval prompt set. Health probes every 5m. If gates fail, immediate rollback.

leila: Legal/product note: EU customers require EU KMS for keys. If we do per-tenant opt-in later, ensure keys are region-bound or document exceptions.

ops-bot: @james scheduled deploy window: 2024-04-12 02:00 UTC. Preflight checklist: capacity check, canary quota, alert hooks.

sara: quick config stub for the flag: ```json
{"flag":"edge_eu_lowlat_v2","cohorts":[{"name":"canary","pct":5}],"fallback":"model-v1","telemetry_keys":["latency.p95","errors.rate","quality.regressions"]}
```

mike: Also propose an A/B inside the canary: 50% of canary requests with caching enabled vs 50% without, to measure token-cost vs p95 tradeoff. Variants: canary-cache / canary-nocache.

james: SRE/circuit-breaker rules: if p95 > 150ms for 10m OR errors.rate > 1% for 5m -> auto-rollback. Who will own the pager?

anna: eng-runtime will own alerting and auto-rollback mechanics. We'll add a canary dashboard (live metrics + regression diffs) and a Sev2 pager if circuit-breaker trips.

leila: CS/Docs: we'll draft customer comms and a support playbook for opt-in customers (what to expect, how to opt-out, contact path).

sara: Proposed checklist/next-steps: - finalize flag config by EOD - ops schedule + reserve quota - create canary dashboard + eval harness (automated regression checks) - draft customer comms and support playbook. Owners: mike(flag & metrics), anna(rollback/alerts), james(ops window), leila(customer comms).

mike: ack. I'll open a flag PR with cohort assignment and add unit tests for deterministic bucket assignment.

ops-bot: Preflight run passed (capacity ok, alerts configured). Deploy scheduled 2024-04-12 02:00 UTC.

sara: Thanks — closing thread for now. Will post back with 24h and 7d signal snippets after bake.
